title: Training and transfer
bodyMd: Employees in a workshop improve their scores on exercises practised during training. Their scores on a different workplace task do not improve. The trainer says the workshop succeeded at teaching the practised exercises but that broader transfer has not been demonstrated. She proposes revising the workshop to include varied applications rather than repeating the same examples more often.
